title: Ijwi riva mu nyenga
intro: Inkuru y’ubwihangane n’imbabazi zitagira imipaka z’Imana iragaragara muri Korowani. Intumwa yoherejwe mu mujyi munini, ariko abantu babo banze umuburo banze ukuri. Mu gucika intege, uyu mwuka waragiye - gusa ugeragerezwa n’inyanja yari irimo imiyaga myinshi maze umira mu mwijima w’icuraburindi. Mu nda y’umwijima, havutse ubusabe bwicishije bugufi, maze Nyir’impuhwe arasubiza. Ni nde uyu mwuka wavuyemo wahindutse, abantu be bakaba abizera barenga ibihumbi ijana?
clues: Natumwe nk'umuburira mu mujyi munini wari ufite abaturage bayobye inzira y'ukwemera.
Nahamagaye abantu banjye mu kuri kenshi, ariko bansetse kandi bakanga ubutumwa bwanjye.
Navuye aho bari mfite agahinda mbere yuko uruhushya rutangwa, nerekeza mu nyanja.
Havutse inkubi y'umuyaga ikomeye, maze njugunywa mu nyanja — hanyuma imira umubiri wose n'inyamaswa nini yo mu nyanja.
Mu mwijima mwinshi — mu nda y'inyanja, mu nda y'inyamaswa, no mu butaka bw'inyanja — naratakambye nti 'Nta yindi mana iriho keretse wowe; icyubahiro ni icyawe; nari mu bakora ibibi.'
Allah yankuye mu bwigunge, kandi ubwo nagarukaga, abantu banjye barenga ibihumbi ijana bari bamaze kwemera ukuri.

outcome.answer: Bakuwe mu mwijima; imbaga nyamwinshi y'abantu yarizeye

arabic: فَلَوْلَا كَانَتْ قَرْيَةٌ ءَامَنَتْ فَنَفَعَهَآ إِيمَـٰنُهَآ إِلَّا قَوْمَ يُونُسَ لَمَّآ ءَامَنُوا۟ كَشَفْنَا عَنْهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْخِزْىِ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَمَتَّعْنَـٰهُمْ إِلَىٰ حِينٍۢ
verse: Then has there not been a [single] city that believed so its faith benefited it except the people of Jonah? When they believed, We removed from them the punishment of disgrace in worldly life and gave them enjoyment [i.e., provision] for a time. (10:98)
